cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Due to weight.

cards.audioText:
P: UAL 342, encountering severe icing at altitude 5400m, what altitude do you recommend?
C: UAL 342, we have several pilot reports which says 4200m is clear of ice.
P: We will request descend to 4200m, UAL 342.
Question: Where did the controller get the information for no ice level?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: UAL 342，在5400m高度遭遇严重结冰，你建议什么高度？
C: UAL 342，我们收到几份飞行员报告，称4200m没有结冰。
P: 我们将请求下降至4200m，UAL 342。
问题：管制员从哪里获得无结冰高度的信息？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. PIREP.

cards.audioText:
C: CSN 3309, Beijing Control, if you read, squawk ident.
C: CSN 3309, squawk ident observed, check your transmitter, I read you 1.
C: CSN 3309, turn right 090, descend to 5400m on standard, we will continue radar control, I read you 1.
Question: What problem does CSN 3309 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CSN 3309，北京管制，如果收到，设置应答机识别。
C: CSN 3309，已观察到应答机识别，检查你的发射机，信号强度1。
C: CSN 3309，右转航向090，按标准气压下降至5400m，我们将继续雷达管制，信号强度1。
问题：CSN 3309有什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A transmitter problem.

cards.audioText:
P: ACA 16, we need to descend to 2500m immediately due to pressurization problem.
C: ACA 16, we can't descend you due to high ground. for descent, turn right, 020 degrees, then cleared to descend to 2000m at your discretion on 29.1 QNH.
Question: What do they have to do before they can descend?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: ACA 16，由于增压问题，我们需要立即下降至2500m。
C: ACA 16，由于地势较高，我们无法让你下降。要下降，先右转航向020，然后按QNH 29.1由你自行决定下降至2000m。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Turn to heading 020 degrees.
choices: Cleared to 2000 meters at pilot discretion.
choicesZh: 由于地势较高而无法下降
由飞行员自行决定下降至2,000米

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, CCA 710, approaching taxiway 23.
C: CCA 710, good evening, taxiway to Runway 07L via Runway 07R, backtrack 07R to taxiway 11.
P: confirm taxi straight ahead, CCA 710.
C: CCA 710, Negative, turn left, backtrack Runway 07R to taxiway 11.

cards.audioTextZh:
P: 塔台，CCA 710，正接近滑行道23。
C: CCA 710，晚上好，经Runway 07R滑向Runway 07L，在Runway 07R上反向滑行至滑行道11。

C: CCA 710，不对，左转，沿Runway 07R反向滑行至滑行道11。
问题：他们将如何到达滑行道11？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. backtrack on Runway 07R

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, Wuhan Tower, radar shows you are 200 feet above glide slope.
P: Tower, CCA 981, roger, we've just lost glide slope indication on the instrument, we are going around as published.
Question: What type of approach was CCA 981 flying before the Missed Approach?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 981，武汉塔台，雷达显示你高于下滑道200 feet。
P: 塔台，CCA 981，收到，我们刚刚失去仪表上的下滑道指示，正在按公布程序复飞。
问题：CCA 981复飞前实施的是什么类型的进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. ILS.

cards.audioText:
P: NWA 968, waiting at holding point 29, request return to the stand, the brakes are overheating.
C: roger, NWA 968, return to the holding bay, first convenient turn left onto taxiway J.
P: left turn onto Taxiway J, NWA 968.
Question: Which taxiway is NWA 968 to use?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: NWA 968，在29等待点等待，请求返回停机位，刹车过热。
C: 收到，NWA 968，返回等待坪，在第一个方便的路口左转进入滑行道J。
P: 左转进入滑行道J，NWA 968。
问题：NWA 968将使用哪条滑行道？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Taxiway J

cards.audioText:
instructed, CSN 330, Beijing Control, CSN 330, if you copy, squawk ident. CSN 330, Transmitting on 121.5.
Question: What is happening between the air traffic controller and the pilot?
cards.audioTextZh:
已指示，CSN 330。北京管制，CSN 330，如果收到，设置应答机识别。CSN 330，在121.5上发射。
问题：空中交通管制员与飞行员之间发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Radio contact has been lost.

cards.audioText:
P: UAL 655, we have serious fuel leak, we are returning.
C: UAL 655, descend to 3300m.
P: leaving 5400m for 3300m, UAL 655.
C: UAL 655, do you require emergency services on landing?
P: Affirm, UAL 655.
Question: What is the problem with the aircraft?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: UAL 655，我们发生严重燃油泄漏，正在返航。
C: UAL 655，下降至3300m。
P: 离开5400m下降至3300m，UAL 655。
C: UAL 655，着陆时需要紧急服务吗？
P: 需要，UAL 655。
问题：航空器发生了什么故障？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Fuel leak

cards.audioText:
P: UAL 350, we can't hold any longer, we have seriously ill passenger onboard.
C: UAL 350, leave the holding pattern, fly heading 050.
P: heading 050, UAL 350.request first aid upon landing.
C: roger, UAL 350.
Question: What will be the immediate need after landing?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: UAL 350，我们无法继续等待，机上有一名病情严重的乘客。
C: UAL 350，离开等待航线，航向050。
P: 航向050，UAL 350，请求着陆后提供急救。
C: 收到，UAL 350。
问题：着陆后立即需要什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Medical service.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CSN 3251, request taxi.
C: CSN 3251, for your information, KAL 236 and CCA 9018 both B747 nearly collided on Runway 14R one minute ago, Stay there now, I will call you back.
P: roger, CSN 3251.
Question: What happened?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，CSN 3251，请求滑行。
C: CSN 3251，提醒你，KAL 236和CCA 9018这两架B747在1分钟前差点于Runway 14R相撞。现在原地等待，我会再次呼叫你。
P: 收到，CSN 3251。
问题：发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. There was almost a collision on the runway.
choices: There was a crash on the runway.
There was almost a collision on the runway.
There was a vehicle on the runway.

cards.audioText:
P: Manchester Ground, UAL 94, we have hydraulic problem, we have lost nose wheel steering, we have to hold position and request send a tug to take us back to the gate.
C: roger, UAL 94, stand by.
C: UAL 94, suggest you shut down the engine, there is a tug for the flight.
P: UAL 94, roger.
Question: What problem does UAL 94 have?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 曼彻斯特地面，UAL 94，我们有液压问题，已失去前轮转向能力，必须原地等待，请求派一辆牵引车将我们拖回登机口。
C: 收到，UAL 94，稍等。
C: UAL 94，建议关闭发动机，已经为该航班安排了一辆牵引车。
P: UAL 94，收到。
问题：UAL 94有什么问题？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A hydraulic problem.
choices: The electrics in the nose of the aircraft.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, AFR 121, Stand Z4, Information F, ready for pushback and startup.
C: AFR 121, the tug A blue for pushback has malfunctioned, I am sending another tug, stand by.
P: Wilco, AFR 121.
Question: Why does the controller ask AFR 121 to wait?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，AFR 121，Z4停机位，通播F，已准备好推出和启动。
C: AFR 121，用于推出的牵引车发生故障，我正在派另一辆牵引车，稍等。
P: 照办，AFR 121。
问题：管制员为什么要求AFR 121等待？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Tug has broken down
choices: There is a vehicle behind the aircraft

cards.audioText:
P: UAL 342, approaching the gate.
C: UAL 342, hold where you are, all passengers have to stay on board, it is reported that there was a bird flu at your departure airport.
Question: What was the reason that the passengers were not allowed to disembark?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: UAL 342，正在接近登机口。
C: UAL 342，在原地等待，所有乘客必须留在机上，据报告你的离场机场发生了禽流感。
问题：为什么不允许乘客下机？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Infectious disease

cards.audioText:
P: QFA 235, hold on taxiway A.
C: QFA 235, hold short for departure, you are No 2 after Airbus 320.
P: holding short, No 2 for departure, QFA 235.
C: QFA 235, line up and wait.
P: line up and wait, QFA 235.
Question: What was the departure sequence for QFA 235?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: QFA 235，在滑行道A上等待。
C: QFA 235，在跑道外等待离场，你排在A320之后，是No. 2。

P: 进入跑道等待，QFA 235。
问题：QFA 235的离场顺序是多少？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Number 2.

cards.audioText:
C: AFR 201, have you reduced to approach speed? you are gaining on the aircraft ahead of you.
P: AFR 201, unable to reduce speed, we have problem with flaps.
C: AFR 201, go around immediately, turn left heading 140, climb and maintain 4000ft for resequence ILS Runway 23L.
Question: Why can't they reduce to approach speed?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: AFR 201，你减至进近速度了吗？你正在接近前方航空器。

C: AFR 201，立即复飞，左转航向140，爬升并保持4000ft，重新排序实施Runway 23L ILS进近。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. They can't extend their flaps.

choicesZh: 他们需要一条更长的跑道

cards.audioText:
P: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, CCA 320, B747, we have shut down No. 2 engine due to excessive vibration, heading now 120 degrees, 600m, current position 20 miles east of HJU, request return to your airport for immediate landing.
Question: What type of aircraft was CCA 320?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，CCA 320，B747，由于振动过大，我们已关闭No. 2发动机。当前航向120度、高度600m，当前位置在HJU以东20 miles，请求返回你机场立即着陆。
问题：CCA 320是什么机型？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Boeing 747

cards.audioText:
P: Chengdu Tower, good morning, SIA 952, established on the ILS.
C: SIA 952, good morning, continue ILS approach Runway 02.
P: continue, SIA 952.
C: SIA 952, we have a report a dog on the runway, so advise caution during approach, you may make a late clarance.
Question: Why did control advise caution to SIA 952?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 成都塔台，早上好，SIA 952，已建立ILS。
C: SIA 952，早上好，继续对Runway 02实施ILS进近。
P: 继续进近，SIA 952。
C: SIA 952，我们收到报告，跑道上有一只狗，因此进近时谨慎，你可能会较晚收到着陆许可。
问题：管制员为什么提醒SIA 952谨慎进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Animal on the runway.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 4326, after departure, climb straight ahead until passing 1200m, then follow flight planned route.
P: after departure, climb straight ahead until passing 1200m, then follow flight planned route, CCA 4326.

Question: Where is the vehicle?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 4326，离场后直线爬升，直至通过1200m，然后按计划航路飞行。
P: 离场后直线爬升，直至通过1200m，然后按计划航路飞行，CCA 4326。
C: CCA 4326，进入跑道等待，有车辆正在穿越跑道逆风端。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. At the opposite end of the runway
choices: At the opposite end of the runway

cards.audioText:
P: Zhengzhou, CSN 309, request descent, our anti-icing system is inoperative.
C: CSN 309, descend to 7000m, we had a pilot report one minutes ago there was moderate turbulence at 8000m over ZHO.
P: down to 7000m, thanks for your alert, CSN 309.
Question: Why does the pilot request descent?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 郑州，CSN 309，请求下降，我们的防冰系统失效。
C: CSN 309，下降至7000m，1分钟前有飞行员报告ZHO上空8000m处有中度湍流。
P: 下降至7000m，谢谢提醒，CSN 309。
问题：飞行员为什么请求下降？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Because of unserviceable anti-ice system.

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, NWA 987, engine fire after takeoff, request turn back for emergency landing.
C: NWA 987, roger MAYDAY, turn right heading 090.
P: NWA 987, we've lost the use of all instruments, the fuel is still burning, we have Runway 22in sight and return to land immediately, out.
Question: What type of approach will NWA 987 carry out?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，NWA 987，起飞后发动机起火，请求返航紧急着陆。
C: NWA 987，收到MAYDAY，右转航向090。
P: NWA 987，我们已无法使用所有仪表，燃油仍在燃烧，我们已看到Runway 22，将立即返航着陆，完毕。
问题：NWA 987将实施什么类型的进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Visual Approach

cards.audioText:
P: CSN 306, request 10 degrees heading change to right of track to detour the CB.
C: roger, CSN 306, turn right 10 degrees heading 260.
P: right heading 260, CSN 306.
C: CSN 306, clear of CB now, resume own navigation, report back on course.
Question: Which heading will be suitable for the aircraft to come back on track?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: CSN 306，请求向航迹右侧改变航向10度，以绕飞CB。
C: 收到，CSN 306，右转10度，航向260。
P: 右转航向260，CSN 306。
C: CSN 306，现已避开CB，恢复自主领航，回到预定航路后报告。
问题：航空器应如何转弯以回到预定航迹？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Turn left

cards.audioText:
C: NWA 482, descend to FL290 now for crossing traffic, be leveled at FL290 in two minutes or less.
P: roger, Descend to FL290 in two minutes or less for crossing, leaving FL330 now, NWA 482.
Question: When should they begin their descent?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: NWA 482，为避让穿越航空器，立即下降至FL290，在2分钟或更短时间内在FL290改平。
P: 收到，为避让穿越航空器，在2分钟或更短时间内下降至FL290，现正离开FL330，NWA 482。
问题：他们应在什么时候开始下降？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Immediately.

cards.audioText:
P: Ground, CSN 3108, I have to go back to the apron and need medical assistance upon arrival, the flight attendant reported a woman onboard is miscarried and needs a doctor.
C: CSN 3108, right turn ahead at intersection E5, we will inform those concerned.
Question: What happened onboard?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 地面，CSN 3108，我必须返回停机坪，并在到达时需要医疗援助。乘务员报告机上一名女性流产，需要医生。
C: CSN 3108，在前方E5交叉口右转，我们将通知相关人员。
问题：机上发生了什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. A Woman was in danger for miscarrying.
choices: A Woman was in danger for miscarrying.
A flight attendant was going to give birth to a baby.
choicesZh: 报告的问题是起落架故障

cards.audioText:
P: Wuhan Control, request go round the CB from the right.
C: CCA 101, negative due to prohibited area (=forbidden area). Turn left 40 degrees track out 30km, report clear of CB.

cards.audioTextZh:
P: 武汉管制，请求从右侧绕飞CB。

问题：为什么不允许CCA 101向左转？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Forbidden area

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, AFR 966, intercepted a distress call from DLH 124, DLH 124 has fuel emergency with 15 minutes endurance, request landing priority, the aircraft position is 15 miles east, 9000ft.
C: AFR 966, roger MAYDAY, break, break.
Question: Which of the following statements is true?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，AFR 966截获了DLH 124的遇险呼叫。DLH 124发生燃油紧急情况，仅剩15分钟续航时间，请求优先着陆；航空器位于东侧15 miles处、高度9000ft。
C: AFR 966，收到MAYDAY，断开，断开。
问题：以下哪一项陈述正确？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. DLH 124 has fuel trouble.

cards.audioText:
P: Tower, AFR 973, we reject takeoff due red lights on the panel came on before V1, request vacating runway immediately, the figure is going on.
C: AFR 973, via first convenient intersection. Taxi via B6 to No. 2 apron.
Question: What reason caused AFR 973 to abort takeoff?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 塔台，AFR 973，由于在V1前面板上的红色警告灯亮起，我们中断起飞，请求立即脱离跑道，警报仍在持续。
C: AFR 973，从第一个方便的交叉口脱离，经B6滑行至No. 2停机坪。
问题：什么原因导致AFR 973中断起飞？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：D. Red warning lights appeared before V1.
choices: Red lights were seen on the runway before V1.
Red lights on another aircraft came out before V1.
Red warning lights appeared before V1.
choicesZh: 在达到V1前看到跑道上有红灯
另一架飞机的红灯在达到V1前亮起
在达到V1前出现了红色飞行物
在达到V1前出现了红色警告灯

cards.audioText:
P: MAYDAY, MAYDAY, MAYDAY, Beijing Control, AFR 342, we lost pressurization, 9200m descending.
C: AFR 342, roger MAYDAY, break, break, all aircraft below 9200m between PB and MB immediately depart route A593 to the east due to emergency descent.
Question: What does Beijing control instruct all aircraft between PB and MB to do?
cards.audioTextZh:

Leave route A593 to the east.

cards.audioText:
C: CCA 981, windshear warning, strong low level windshear observed in the vicinity of Beijing airport at 1400 hours, what's your intention?
P: we'd like to delay our approach 30 minutes, CCA 981.

cards.audioTextZh:
C: CCA 981，风切变警告，1400时在北京机场附近观测到强低空风切变，报告你的意图。
P: 我们希望将进近推迟30分钟，CCA 981。
问题：他们为什么希望推迟进近？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. Because of wind condition.

cards.audioText:
C: JAL 785, the ground mechanics reported that two white navigational light and one stroke light below APU exhaust off.
P: is that so, we have to check the MEL.
P: Ground, JAL 785, it's not airworthy, we will taxi back to park for replacement.
Question: Why did the aircraft taxi back?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: JAL 785，地面机务人员报告，APU排气口下方的两盏白色航行灯和一盏频闪灯熄灭。
P: 是吗？我们必须检查MEL。
P: 地面，JAL 785，该航空器不适航，我们将滑行返回停机位更换故障灯。
问题：航空器为什么滑行返回？

choices: Not in an air operating condition

cards.audioText:
BAW 309, we are unable to control pressurization, cabin altitude is rising rapidly, request immediate descent to FL120.
C: BAW 309, roger, descend to FL120, report reaching.
P: descending to FL120, wilco, BAW 309.

cards.audioTextZh:
P: BAW 309，我们无法控制增压，客舱高度正在迅速上升，请求立即下降至FL120。
C: BAW 309，收到，下降至FL120，到达后报告。
P: 正在下降至FL120，照办，BAW 309。
问题：航空器正下降至哪个高度层，原因是什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. FL120 due to depressurization

cards.audioText:
P: Departure, AFR 667, passing 6000ft, request FL250.
C: AFR 667, negative for FL250 for the moment, climb to FL210, expedite until passing FL170, report passing FL170 and FL190.
P: roger, climbing to FL210, and expediting, call you when passing FL170 and FL190, AFR 667.
Question: At which level should AFR 667 slow down climb?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 离场，AFR 667，正通过6000ft，请求FL250。
C: AFR 667，暂时无法批准FL250，爬升至FL210，加速爬升直至通过FL170，报告通过FL170和FL190。
P: 收到，爬升至FL210并加速爬升，通过FL170和FL190时呼叫你，AFR 667。
问题：AFR 667应在哪个高度层减小爬升率？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. After passing FL170.

cards.audioText:
P: CCA 982, we are unable to lower the landing gear, request proceed to hold to have a complete check.
P: CCA 982, flaps are still jammed, we have manually cranked down the main gear, but not the nose gear, request emergency landing.
C: CCA 982, set heading to LR, and hold, report when ready to leave.
Question: What does the crew request initially?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: CCA 982，我们无法放下起落架，请求前往等待航线进行全面检查。
P: CCA 982，襟翼仍然卡住，我们已用手摇方式放下主起落架，但前起落架尚未放下，请求紧急着陆。
C: CCA 982，飞向LR并等待，准备离开时报告。
问题：机组最初提出了什么请求？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. Join the holding pattern for check.
choices: Join the holding pattern for check.
Make a low pass for visual check.
choicesZh: 加入等待航线进行检查
低空通场以便目视检查

cards.audioText:
P: B Ground, DAL 153, request departure information.
C: DAL 153, runway in use for takeoff 18L, wind 260, 10 knots, gusting to 20 knots temperature 10, dew point 9, QNH1012 taxiway W between C and D partially closed due work in progress.
Question: Why is the taxiway partially closed?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: B地面，DAL 153，请求离场情报。
C: DAL 153，起飞使用Runway 18L，风向260度、风速10 knots、阵风20 knots，气温10度、露点9度，QNH 1012。由于正在施工，滑行道W在C和D之间部分关闭。
问题：为什么该滑行道部分关闭？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Due work in progress.

cards.audioText:
P: Beijing Approach, CCA 981, No. 2 engine flamed out during climbing, we intend to return to land, but we have to dump 20 tons of fuel first.
C: CCA 982, set heading to YV, after passing YV, heading 350, to start dumping, upon completion, turn left heading 160 to YV, maintain 5100m.
Question: What can we learn from this exchange?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: 北京进近，CCA 981，No. 2发动机在爬升过程中熄火，我们打算返航着陆，但必须先放掉20 tons燃油。
C: CCA 982，飞向YV，通过YV后航向350，开始放油；完成后左转航向160返回YV，保持5100m。
问题：从这段通话中可以得知什么？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. CCA 981's is too heavy to land safely.
choices: CCA 981's is too heavy to land safely.
CCA 981 is coming back due to bird ingestion.
CCA 981 is coming back due engine overheating.
CCA 981 is holding for fuel jettison.

cards.audioText:
Center, CCA 106, we are experiencing moderate icing between FL240 and 260, de-icing equipment is unserviceable, request descend to FL210.
CCA 106, descend to FL210, report reaching.
Question: What happened to CCA 106?
cards.audioTextZh:
管制，CCA 106，我们在FL240至FL260之间遭遇中度积冰，除冰设备失效，请求下降至FL210。
CCA 106，下降至FL210，到达后报告。

cards.referenceText: 正确答案：B. They ran into moderate icing and de-icing equipment failed.
choices: They were caught in moderate icing between FL210 and 240.
They ran into moderate icing and de-icing equipment failed.
They were caught in thunderstorm between FL240 and 260.
They were caught in moderate icing and anti-icing equipment failed.
choicesZh: 他们在FL210至FL240之间遭遇中度结冰
他们遭遇中度结冰且除冰设备失效
他们在FL240至FL260之间遭遇雷暴
他们遭遇中度结冰且防冰设备失效

cards.audioText:
C: UAL 201, you are taking the wrong direction, taxiway F is closed due to emergency traffic. Turn left to taxiway D and A to the holding point of Runway 09.
P: Turn left to taxiway D and A to the holding point of Runway 09, UAL 201.
Question: Why was taxiway F closed?
cards.audioTextZh:
C: UAL 201，你的滑行方向错误，F滑行道因紧急航空器而关闭。左转，经D和A滑行道滑行至Runway 09等待点。
P: 左转，经D和A滑行道滑行至Runway 09等待点，UAL 201。
问题：F滑行道为什么关闭？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：C. An emergency traffic had not vacated the taxiway F.
choices: Its lighting system was out of service.
A broken traffic had skidded off the runway.
An emergency traffic had not vacated the taxiway F.
An emergency traffic took the wrong direction.
choicesZh: 一辆故障车辆滑出跑道
一架紧急航空器尚未脱离F滑行道
一架紧急航空器走错了方向

cards.audioText:
Panpan, panpan, panpan, New York Tower, BAW 452, we have an engine fire warning light. We have completed emergency checklist procedure, warning light remains illuminated. however, there is no visible signs of fire. We will need to vacate the runway, request taxi instructions.
Question: What action did the crew take?
cards.audioTextZh:
PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，纽约塔台，BAW 452，我们的发动机火警灯亮起。我们已完成紧急检查单程序，但警告灯仍然亮着。不过，没有可见的起火迹象。我们需要脱离跑道，请求滑行指令。
问题：机组采取了什么行动？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. They did the emergency checklist.
choices: They shut down the faulty engine.
They extinguished the fire on engine.
choicesZh: 他们执行了紧急检查单
他们关闭了故障发动机
他们扑灭了发动机火灾

cards.audioText:
P: Mayday, Mayday, Mayday, Sierra Approach, BAW 983, emergency descent from FL310 to FL120 due sudden and rapid depressurization, heading 190, approaching SEG.
C: BAW 983, roger Mayday. Squawk 7700, report reaching FL120. No traffic in your area.
Question: For what reason did the crew declare a distress call?
cards.audioTextZh:
P: MAYDAY，MAYDAY，MAYDAY，Sierra进近，BAW 983，因突然且快速失压，正从FL310紧急下降至FL120，航向190，正在接近SEG。
C: BAW 983，收到MAYDAY。应答机7700，到达FL120时报告。你所在区域没有其他航空器。
问题：机组因为什么原因发出遇险呼叫？
cards.referenceText: 正确答案：A. Sudden depressurization.
